title: Personal Portfolio
description: This website. A fast, accessible single-page portfolio with a Markdown-powered blog, dark and light themes, and project data kept separate from the layout so it's easy to update.

title: SQL Practice Platform
description: A LeetCode-style practice site focused only on SQL. Write a query, run it instantly in the browser on a real Postgres (PGlite), then submit it to be graded against hidden test cases full of NULLs, ties and boundary dates. Includes a Monaco editor with table and column completion, a schema viewer, and accounts with submission history and progress tracking.
